title: auth commands return &'static str instead of Response type
description: In session/commands/auth.rs, authinfo_response and related helpers return &'static str bare wire strings instead of the Response struct used everywhere else. This bypasses the Response abstraction: callers must manually write_all these strings, any code-in-text mistake will not be caught by the Response constructor, and the inconsistency makes the codebase harder to maintain. All command handlers should return Response.
